items.name: CommentRanges
items.summary: Stores the ranges of comments sorted by [`TextRange::start`] in increasing order. No two ranges are overlapping.

methods.name: block_comments
methods.summary: Given a [`CommentRanges`], determine which comments are grouped together in "comment blocks". A "comment block" is a sequence of consecutive own-line comments in which the comment hash (`#`) appears in the same column in each line, and at…

methods.name: comments_in_range
methods.summary: Returns the comments who are within the range

methods.name: has_comments
methods.signature: fn has_comments<T>(&self, node: &T, source: &str) -> bool where T: Ranged
methods.summary: Returns `true` if a statement or expression includes at least one comment.

methods.name: intersects
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the given range intersects with any comment range.

methods.name: is_own_line
methods.summary: Returns `true` if a comment is an own-line comment (as opposed to an end-of-line comment).
